name: Azariah
description: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him fourscore priests of the Lord, that were valiant men: and they withstood Uzziah the king. All the priests said, what are you doing? They withstood him.

And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked upon him, and, behold, he was leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out from thence; yea, himself hasted also to go out, because the Lord had smitten him. God smote him because of pride.
